resources.string: Press OK to pick up an app · Back when done
Arrows move the app · OK drops it here
That can\'t be opened on this TV

Opens Edit Home Screen: every icon wiggles. Press OK on an app to pick it up, move it with the arrows (up/down jump a whole row), press OK to drop it, then pick up the next one. Press Back when you\'re done. Also on the Home screen: hold OK on any app → Edit Home Screen or Move to Top Row, or hold OK on Settings → Rearrange Apps.
Show artwork in the Top Shelf: %1$s

For Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube, Apple TV, JioHotstar and other streaming apps, the Top Shelf shows the newest releases on that service (new series first, then new seasons and episodes) with their backdrops, from tvmaze.com, checked every 3 hours. Android only lets its built-in launcher read the apps\' own posters.
Ad blocking: On (AdGuard Family: ads + adult sites)
Block ads, trackers and adult sites

Uses Android\'s built-in Private DNS with AdGuard\'s free DNS, so ad and tracker servers are blocked for every app on the TV. No VPN or extra app. It can\'t remove YouTube or Netflix in-video ads, which come from the same servers as the videos. Needs USB debugging (see How this works).
Ad blocking is on: a test ad server was blocked and the internet still works.
Ad blocking is set. The test ad server wasn\'t blocked yet; it usually takes effect within a minute.
Your network blocks secure DNS, so ad blocking would have taken the TV offline. It has been switched back off.
Make Glass your permanent Home screen and clean up preinstalled apps.
Lock Glass as the main launcher

Sets Glass as the default Home app, turns off the original launcher and switches on Home Guard. Needs USB debugging on (see How this works). Accept the \"Allow debugging?\" prompt and tick Always allow.
Opens Accessibility settings. Choose Glass Launcher Home Guard and turn it on. Home Guard sends the Home button back to Glass and closes the original launcher whenever it appears.
Select apps, then press Disable. Disabled apps disappear completely but are not deleted, so you can bring them back here at any time.
No preinstalled extras were found on this TV.

Locking Glass and removing bloatware use the TV's own debugging connection, the same access a PC gets with adb.

1. Settings → Device Preferences (or System) → About: press OK on Build 7 times.
2. Settings → Developer options: turn on USB debugging, and Network debugging if your TV lists it.
3. Come back here, press a button, and accept the "Allow debugging?" prompt (tick Always allow).

If it says it can't connect, your TV only offers Wireless debugging. From a PC, run "adb connect TV-IP" once, then "adb tcpip 5555", and try again. Needs Android 8 or newer.

Keeps Glass Launcher as your Home screen. When you press Home, or the original launcher opens, it switches back to Glass Launcher. It doesn\'t read or collect anything on screen.
